title: Speaking — Working with others
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on working with others.

questions: Where do you usually go if you need to study or read?
Do you prefer to learn in the morning or evening?
How do you keep track of what you have learned?
What helps you get back to studying after a break?
When do you usually need to work with another person?
Which responsibilities do you enjoy sharing?

part2.topic: Describe a task you completed successfully as part of a team.
part2.closing: and explain what made the team effective.

questions: What should schools teach about teamwork?
Why can groups with different viewpoints reach better decisions?
How has everyday life connected with working with others changed for people of different ages?
